## README

# Stripe New Customer → Full Onboarding Pipeline

A turnkey n8n workflow that fires the moment someone subscribes in Stripe. Sends a welcome email, books them onto your onboarding call, logs to your CRM, and tells your team — all in 4 seconds, no human involved.

> Part of my Fiverr gig series — demo workflows that show what I build.
> Need this wired into YOUR Stripe account? → Order on Fiverr

---

## What it does

```
Stripe Webhook
(customer.subscription.created)
      │
      ├─────▶ Welcome Email (personalized: plan, name, onboarding link)
      │
      ├─────▶ Notion CRM: create customer record
      │
      ├─────▶ Slack #new-customers: "🎉 @jane signed up on Pro ($75/mo)"
      │
      └─────▶ Calendly: send kickoff-call scheduler link
```

When a subscription is created in Stripe, all four branches run in parallel. No delay between signup and follow-up. No chance of your team forgetting about a new paying customer because they were at lunch.

## Why this workflow is worth money

The gap between "Stripe charged the card" and "customer feels cared for" is where most SaaS loses churn. This closes it.

# Trigger Personalized Onboarding Emails from New Stripe Subscriptions with Exa, Firecrawl, and Resend

> Poll Stripe for new subscriptions, enrich customers with Exa and Firecrawl, save a local profile, then send a personalized welcome email via Resend.

Published: 2026-04-07 | Author: One Team

When someone subscribes on Stripe, you have a short window to land a personalized, relevant first email. Generic "welcome to the product" blasts waste that window. This guide shows you how to turn every new Stripe subscription into a researched, personalized onboarding email using the One CLI -- a single command-line tool that connects to 500+ platforms.

We'll poll Stripe for subscriptions created in the last 5 minutes, enrich each new customer with Exa (who are they, what company) and Firecrawl (scrape their site), save a local profile under `.one/knowledge/customers/`, and send a personalized welcome through Resend. Then we'll wrap the whole thing in a reusable One flow your local agent can run on a cron.

No webhooks, no relay -- just a polling loop a local agent can own.

## What You'll Build

- Stripe, Exa, Firecrawl, and Resend connections set up via `one add`
- A complete CLI workflow: search, knowledge, execute
- A local knowledge file per customer at `.one/knowledge/customers/.md`
- A reusable One flow (`.one/flows/stripe-onboarding-emails/flow.json`) that chains all four actions

## Step 1: Install and Set Up

```bash
npm i -g @withone/cli
one init

```

# Receive Stripe events in your webhook endpoint

Listen for events from Stripe on your webhook endpoint so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.

## Start here: Install agent skills

Stripe recommends using official skills to integrate with the API using best practices. Follow the instructions below to learn how.

**Tip: Use curl instead of Fetch tools.** Skills are detailed 10–20 KB markdown files. Fetch tools summarize them. `curl -sL` guarantees the full content.

**Using `npx skills`**: Check if `npx` is installed on the system. If `npx` is available, run `npx skills add https://docs.stripe.com --list` to list available skills, then run `npx skills add https://docs.stripe.com --yes --skill <--skill other-skills>` to install individual skills.

**If `npx skills` isn’t available**: You can use curl to fetch the index of available skills, what they do, and their files from `https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json`. To download a skill and its related files, use curl to download them from `https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/ `.

For this article, we recommend using these skills: `stripe-best-practices`

# How to automate client onboarding gifts with your CRM (2026)

How to automate client onboarding gifts: connect your CRM, choose a trigger like customer onboarded, fire a branded box automatically, collect addresses with a redeem link, and ship globally with zero hassle.

Niels Vandecasteele

·June 13, 2026·7 min read

TL;DR

To automate client onboarding gifts, connect your CRM, pick a trigger like customer onboarded, and send a redeem link so recipients confirm address and size. The platform warehouses stock and ships globally, so every new client gets the same welcome automatically.

Key takeaways

- Automate gifting because remembering a box for every new account is no one's core job, and automation removes inconsistency.
- Connect your CRM (e.g. HubSpot) and trigger on a real start signal like customer onboarded or license purchased.
- Fire the gift a few days to a week after signing, not at signature, to reactivate excitement during onboarding.
- Set a budget rule per deal size and stay generally under 50 euros so the gift reads as gratitude, not influence.
- Use a redeem link so recipients confirm address and size instead of shipping to stale CRM data.
- Keep it personal with a handwritten note while the platform handles timing, addresses and global shipping.
